finacle.notes: Original header logo downloaded from the official Finacle website through its browser asset inventory; original pixels preserved.

temenos.notes: Original transparent SVG used in the official Temenos website header. Original colors preserved for parent CSS grayscale styling.

dealcloud.notes: Original Intapp DealCloud logo from Intapp's public media library. Self-contained SVG includes an embedded PNG image; no external image dependencies.

lseg.notes: Original transparent SVG used in the official LSEG website header.

guidewire.notes: Original transparent SVG linked by https://www.guidewire.com/ and served by Guidewire's Sitecore media CDN.

maximo.notes: Official IBM eight-bar mark from IBM's public bamoe-docs repository, identifying Maximo's parent brand. Original artwork retained, including its white square background and padding; this asset is not transparent.

aveva-pi.notes: Original transparent AVEVA corporate logo from the official AVEVA PI System page, https://www.aveva.com/en/products/aveva-pi-system/. Identifies AVEVA PI System's parent brand.

netbox.notes: Original transparent NetBox dark-teal logo from the official netbox-community/netbox repository, pinned to commit 3c6fce65200e468b2edc3b3f0bb1ba553994564c.

laserfiche.notes: Original transparent Laserfiche logotype used in the official website header.

veeva-vault.notes: Original transparent 300 × 69 PNG Veeva corporate logo used in the official website header, as requested for Veeva Vault.

imanage.notes: Original transparent 1134 × 433 PNG iManage logo. The official homepage references this asset with a WebP delivery query; the original PNG was downloaded without that conversion query.
